Step 1: Start date 1455-12-25.  
Step 2: 11 weeks + 6 days = 11×7 + 6 = 83 days.  
Step 3: 1455 is not a leap year (divisible by 100 but not by 400).  
Days in Dec after 25: 6 days left → 83 − 6 = 77 days left to add.  
Step 4: Jan 1456 has 31 days → 77 − 31 = 46 left.  
Feb 1456 is leap year? 1456 divisible by 4 and not by 100 → leap year → 29 days → 46 − 29 = 17 left.  
March 1456: day 17 → 1456-03-17.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1456-03-17
